crossRefs.note: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.
For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your…
for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…
